hero.subtitle1: A festival for those who have something to say —

manifeste.desc1: Genius is born from resistance, never from abundance.
manifeste.desc2: MARSAI dictates a single rule: one minute, one AI, one truth.
manifeste.desc3: What you achieve within this frame will be greater than you believed possible.
manifeste.c1_desc: Every work is limited to 60 seconds. The time constraint is the first of creative freedoms.
manifeste.c2_desc: No real filming. The entire film — visuals, sound, narrative — is generated by artificial intelligence.
manifeste.c3_desc: Despite the tools, the emotion must be true. AI is the brush. Humanity remains the subject.

programme.title: Three days
programme.day2_d3: 21:00 — Dark Night Party (Live Performances / AI VJing)

theme.quote: What if AI wasn't the threat, but the mirror in which humanity finally sees what it wants to become?

jury.intro: Four gazes. Four continents. One common demand: that emotion precedes technique, that humanity emerges from the algorithm.

1.bio: Pioneer of European generative cinema. Founder of Chromatic AI studio, awarded at the Venice Film Festival.

2.bio: Master of narrative image. 20 years of research on the convergence between human emotion and creative algorithm.

3.bio: Composer and researcher in generative music. Her works have been performed in 30 countries.

4.bio: Author of "The Algorithm Gaze". Editor for Sight & Sound, specialist in post-cinema.

recompenses.gpDesc: Awarded to the film that best embodies the festival's vision: genuine emotion carried by AI. Open to all — first film or tenth, emotion alone counts. The jury votes unanimously.

jury.title: Jury Prize
jury.desc: Awarded to the most formally audacious work. The one that breaks the rules in the most convincing way.

revelation.title: Revelation Prize
revelation.desc: For those submitting their very first film. No résumé required — just a story to tell. This prize exists precisely for you.

certification.title: MARSAI Certification
certification.desc: Awarded to the 50 finalist films, regardless of experience. International recognition and access to the MARSAI community.

alliances.intro: The Marsai ecosystem brings together world leaders in artificial intelligence and digital creation. More than sponsors, they are the architects of tomorrow's cinema, without whom this revolution would not be possible.

partnerBlock.desc: Marsai Festival is the launchpad for tomorrow's generative technologies. Associate your brand with the avant-garde of global cinema.

01.name: Sora Studio
01.desc: Pioneer of high-fidelity video generation. Official technology partner for festival workshops.
01.descLong: Sora Studio has been pushing the limits of video generation since 2022. Their temporal diffusion engine can create coherent cinematographic sequences spanning several minutes — a revolution for independent filmmakers. For MARSAI, Sora Studio provides early API access for all 600 competition participants.

02.name: Anthropic Labs
02.desc: Fundamental research in responsible AI. Supporting the creation of next-generation narrative tools.
02.descLong: Anthropic Labs is at the forefront of constitutional AI research. Their work on generated narrativity opens new territories for creators. For MARSAI, Anthropic contributes art direction tools accessible to all participants regardless of technical level.

03.name: CNC
03.desc: National Center for Cinema and the moving image. Official recognition of the festival in the French cultural landscape.
03.descLong: The CNC brings its institutional legitimacy to MARSAI. This official recognition allows award-winning works to access CNC support programs for feature-length development — a concrete bridge between experimental creation and the French film industry.

04.name: EDF Pulse
04.desc: Acceleration program for innovative cultural projects. Infrastructure endowment for finalists.
04.descLong: EDF Pulse has been supporting projects at the intersection of technology and culture since 2015. Their dedicated digital creation program offers MARSAI finalists access to high-performance computing infrastructure — essential for the demanding video rendering of AI generation.

galerie.tagline: One-minute films created with A.I. — by enthusiasts from all walks of life.

f1.title: Synthetic Memory
f1.desc: A poetic exploration of urban memory through the eye of a failing algorithm.

f2.title: Shatter of Nothing
f2.desc: Artificial intelligence reinvents the myth of Icarus in a breathtaking visual symphony.

f3.title: The Last Frequency
f3.desc: When the machine learns to cry. A fictitious documentary about the first synthetic feelings.
